description_en: Creates a policy route table for an Enterprise Edition transit router
description_zh: 为企业版转发路由器创建策略路由表
name: CreateTransitRouterPolicyTable

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例 ID
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the policy route table
parameters.help_zh: 策略路由表实例的名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the policy route table
parameters.help_zh: 策略路由表实例的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the creation request. The dry run includes permission and instance status checks. Valid values:

false (default): sends a regular request and performs only a check. If the request passes the check, the policy route table is created.
true: sends a dry run request and performs only a check without creating the policy route table. The system checks whether required parameters are specified and validates the request format. If the request fails the check, the corresponding error code is returned. If the request passes the check, the corresponding request ID is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。取值：

false（默认）：发送正常请求，只进行校验，通过检查后直接创建策略路由表。
true：发送检查请求，只进行校验，不会创建策略路由表。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回对应请求ID
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The tags of the policy route table
parameters.help_zh: 策略路由表实例绑定的标签列表
parameters.name: tag

PolicyTableId.description_en: The ID of the policy route table
